definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tkanta, speċjalment bħala professjoni jew arti

usage_examples.mt: L-għanqiet sħan huma importanti għas-saħħa mentali.

usage_examples.en: He always showed wisdom in the important decisions of his life.

usage_examples.mt: Bil-maturità jiġi l-għaqal u l-fehma t-tajba tal-affarijiet.

usage_examples.mt: Niesna bdew jgħaqru minnu wara li semgħu l-għidut.

definitions.text_en: union (institution or commitment by which two or more persons become united, e.g. marriage)

definitions.text_en: society, alliance, league, club (body of members formally organised for some purpose)
definitions.text_mt: Grupp organizzat ta' nies iffurmat għal skop partikolari, bħal klabb jew alleanza

usage_examples.mt: Il-għaqda tal-ħaddiema ġġieldu għal kundizzjonijiet aħjar.
usage_examples.en: The workers' union fought for better conditions.

usage_examples.mt: Iż-żwieġ huwa għaqda qaddisa bejn raġel u mara.
usage_examples.en: Marriage is a sacred union between a man and a woman.

usage_examples.mt: L-għaqda bejn il-membri tat-tim kienet notevoli.
usage_examples.en: The unity among the team members was remarkable.

definitions.text_en: synonym of unjoni ċivili: civil union
definitions.text_mt: Unjoni legali bejn żewġ persuni, rikonoxxuta mill-istat, li tagħti drittijiet u responsabbiltajiet simili għaż-żwieġ

usage_examples.mt: Huma għażlu li jagħmlu għaqda ċivili minflok jiżżewġu l-knisja.
usage_examples.en: They chose to enter a civil union instead of getting married in church.

usage_examples.mt: L-għaqdiet ċivili huma protetti mil-liġi f'Malta.
usage_examples.en: Civil unions are protected by law in Malta.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu l-għaqal, li jaħseb u jaġixxi b'mod razzjonali u prudenti

usage_examples.mt: Kien għaqli biżżejjed biex ma jinvestix il-flus kollha f'riskju wieħed.
usage_examples.en: He was wise enough not to invest all his money in one risk.

usage_examples.mt: Deċiżjoni għaqlija tista' tiffranka ħafna problemi fil-futur.
usage_examples.en: A prudent decision can save many problems in the future.

usage_examples.mt: Il-proġett għaqqad it-teknoloġija mat-tradizzjoni b'suċċess kbir.

definitions.text_mt: Kostellazzjoni kbira viżibbli fis-sema tan-Nofsinhar, li tixbah lill-forma ta' skorpjun

usage_examples.mt: Stajna naraw il-kostellazzjoni ta' L-Għaqreb b'mod ċar dak il-lejl.

usage_examples.mt: Twelet taħt is-sinjal tal-Għaqreb, li jagħmilha persuna passjonata.
usage_examples.en: She was born under the sign of Scorpio, which makes her a passionate person.

definitions.text_mt: Spazju kbir naturali taħt l-art jew gewwa muntanja, bi ftuħ minn barra

usage_examples.mt: L-għar kien jintuża mill-bnedmin tal-qedem bħala kenn.
usage_examples.en: The cave was used by ancient humans as shelter.

usage_examples.mt: Ħa għar kbir quddiem in-nies meta nstab jigdeb.
usage_examples.en: He suffered great disgrace in front of people when he was caught lying.

usage_examples.mt: L-għerien ta' Għar Dalam huma fost l-aktar importanti f'Malta.

entry.source_citation: Wiktionary: għar u każa (Alternative spelling of għarukaża)

definitions.text_mt: Ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni li ġġib għar u mistħija kbira lill-persuna kkonċernata

usage_examples.mt: Kien għar u każa meta nkixfet l-iskandlu fil-gazzetti kollha.
usage_examples.en: It was a great disgrace when the scandal was exposed in all the newspapers.

usage_examples.mt: Dak li għamel ġab għar u każa fuq il-familja kollha.
usage_examples.en: What he did brought great shame upon the whole family.

definitions.text_mt: B'żaqq vojt, mingħajr ma wieħed ikun kiel ikel minn mindu qam

usage_examples.mt: It-tabib qalli li għandi nieħu l-mediċina għar-riq kull filgħodu.
usage_examples.en: The doctor told me I should take the medicine on an empty stomach every morning.

usage_examples.mt: Għar-riq, kafè jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-istonku.
usage_examples.en: On an empty stomach, coffee can harm the stomach.

definitions.text_mt: Għasfur ta' daqs kbir ta' lewn iswed, li jinstab f'ħafna partijiet tad-dinja u magħruf għall-għajta qawwija tiegħu

usage_examples.mt: L-għarab tant kienu jgħajtu filgħaxija li ma stajt norqod.
usage_examples.en: The crows were cawing so loudly in the evening that I could not sleep.

usage_examples.mt: L-irgħab ġew fl-għelieqi malli bdew jaħartu l-art.
usage_examples.en: The ravens came to the fields as soon as they started ploughing the land.

definitions.text_en: to recognise, become aware of, find out
definitions.text_mt: Jagħraf xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li diġà ra, iltaqa' magħha, jew kellu esperjenza tagħha qabel

usage_examples.mt: Għaraftu minn mal-bogħod għax kien jilbes libsa ħamra.
usage_examples.en: I recognised him from far away because he was wearing a red suit.

usage_examples.mt: Għaraf li kien hemm xi ħaġa ħażina mill-ewwel daqqa t'għajn.
usage_examples.en: He became aware that something was wrong at first glance.

usage_examples.mt: Wara ħafna riċerka, għaraf il-verità wara l-istorja kollha.
usage_examples.en: After much research, he found out the truth behind the whole story.
